title: Dauphin's Countryfest Campground

services.name: Admission Tickets
services.desc: This is a 4-day General Admission ticket into the festival for ages 13 and over. Ages 12 and under are free when accompanied by an adult. 4 days of festival camping! Camping locations include: Upper, Heritage, Fisher Quiet, Fisher Regular, and Lower Reserved. Larger lot camping locations include: Fisher Premium and Lower Reserved Premium Once a campsite is purchased, if you are requesting a campsite transfer there will be a $50.00 transfer fee that must be paid prior to site transfer. ** Reserve your seats in the amphitheatre for the weekend in any of the 3 Reserved Seating sections in the amphitheatre. This does not include admission into the festival. Valid festival admission passes must
